records.name: Frozen phi fit: all other inputs unchanged

energy_local_test.name: Raise only Lambda400; keep Lambda80/158 frozen

scope: Frozen-phi cross-species stress test and shared-template compatibility fit; not a complete new native PYTHIA tune.

data_roles.absolute: NA27 meson cross sections and differential bins; NA61 phi multiplicities.
data_roles.shape: NA60 corrected mass subtotal and pT shapes; one mass count normalization shared across sources.

assumptions: No free QRA normalization. Phi settings frozen before refitting.

Ordinary rho QRA follows the independent g_rhoNN=2.9 vector-coupling benchmark in arXiv:2409.09123 section 4.2; tensor sensitivity checked separately. It is not inferred by dividing the full proton FF by a narrow rho pole.
Omega and phi use isolated poles extracted numerically from the unchanged supplied UA FF curves.

NA60 added electromagnetic current uses the supplied complex F1/F2, with narrow omega and phi pole amplitudes removed for the published corrected subtotal. This follows an incoherent narrow-source subtraction convention; interference and the experimental unfolding of a hard extra source are not validated.
Inclusive pp quantities add reflected beam and target sources. Forward bins use the beam contribution, not a factor of two.
pp-to-nucleus ratios and broadening use the previous nuisance model, including identical relative nuclear scaling for the added subtotal and rho.
The QRA support remains 0.1<E/P<0.9 and applicability cut 0.05. Missing support is not a claim of zero physics.
pi0/eta differential templates are retained and scored, not retuned by new independent bin weights. Their existing residuals remain visible.
Coefficients rescale parent templates; this is not a regenerated event sample with altered resonance feeddown.
Scores are diagonal residual diagnostics; missing correlations and response prevent confidence-level claims.
form_factor_policy: Follow literature curves. No new resonance mass/width/residue scan. Existing bands do not span full form-factor model uncertainty.

not_validated: NA60 acceptance/unfolding for a new hard current
universal rho decomposition common to the strong-coupling benchmark and UA current

nominal_policy: Use the central UA form-factor model and its existing joint refit for nominal predictions. The tabulated minimum/maximum complex values are pointwise uncertainty extrema, not a single coherent model curve; their numerical jumps must not define a nominal mass spectrum. The best score among the archived alternatives remains recorded separately.
